title: One design specification. Two renderers. One verified deck.
takeaway: A shared, structured slide specification should drive preview and native PowerPoint output, followed by output-level quality checks.
compositionBrief: A precise left-to-right architecture diagram with a shared specification feeding two output paths. Use editable native rectangles, labels and connectors. Keep the diagram readable, aligned and free of iconography or pseudo-3D objects.

elements.text: One design specification. Two renderers. One verified deck.

elements.description: The intended PPD architecture: a brief and evidence are converted into a structured slide specification; that specification drives high-fidelity preview/PDF and native PowerPoint renderers; both outputs are inspected before delivery. This diagram describes the target architecture, not the current implementation boundary.
